questions.stem: Germline mutation of MyD88 is associated with:
questions.solutionHtml:
Pulmonary infection
  • Germline mutation of MyD88 is associated with susceptibility to certain types of infections, particularly those caused by bacteria and fungi. Hence, Option C. Pulmonary infection is correct.
  • MyD88 is a key component of the Toll-like receptor (TLR) signaling pathway, which plays an essential role in innate immunity and the detection of pathogens.
  • Mutations in MyD88 have been identified in individuals with increased susceptibility to infections such as pneumococcal disease, as well as in patients with certain immunodeficiency disorders.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 702

questions.stem: A most common cause of community-acquired pneumonia is:
questions.solutionHtml:
S.pneumoniae
  • Streptococcus pneumoniae, or pneumococcus, is the most common cause of community-acquired acute pneumonia.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 703
